description: This file is a Perl module implementing SVN log functionality, including parsing logs, displaying commit information, handling dates, and interfacing with Git and SVN commands.

methods.name: cmt_showable
methods.description: Determines if a commit object can be shown, possibly fetching additional data from Git objects if necessary.

methods.name: log_use_color
methods.description: Checks if color should be used in log output, based on configuration.

methods.name: git_svn_log_cmd
methods.description: Constructs the Git command for retrieving SVN logs with specified revision range and additional arguments.

methods.name: config_pager
methods.description: Configures the pager for log output based on environment and user settings.

methods.name: run_pager
methods.description: Runs the configured pager process for displaying output.

methods.name: format_svn_date
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into SVN date string with timezone information.

methods.name: parse_git_date
methods.description: Parses a date string with timezone into a Unix timestamp.

methods.name: set_local_timezone
methods.description: Sets the environment variable for local timezone based on the stored $TZ value.

methods.name: tz_to_s_offset
methods.description: Converts a timezone string to seconds offset.

methods.name: get_author_info
methods.description: Retrieves and formats author information for a commit, including raw and parsed details.

methods.name: process_commit
methods.description: Decides whether to show or defer a commit based on revision range parameters.

methods.name: show_commit
methods.description: Displays commit information, either in one line or detailed format.

methods.name: show_commit_changed_paths
methods.description: Displays the changed paths of a commit.

methods.name: show_commit_normal
methods.description: Displays detailed normal format of commit information, including message, author, date, and changed paths.

methods.name: cmd_show_log
methods.description: Implements the command for showing logs with revision filtering, paging, and formatting.

methods.name: cmd_blame
methods.description: Implements the blame command, showing per-line revision and author info for a file.
